status_notes: The Document Control table (PDF p. 7) lists 231.0-B-1 (September 2003), B-2 (September 2010) and B-3 (September 2017) as superseded and 231.0-B-4 (July 2021) as the 'Current issue' (clarifies the short LDPC code procedures and adds USLP support). contents.title: Managed Parameters for BCH and LDPC Coding

key_points.text: Technical Corrigendum 1 (July 2026) changes only 5.2.4.2: a revised LDPC (128,64) Tail Sequence, a new note 3 and decoding-probability details in the requirement and note 2.
The modified BCH code can be decoded in error-detecting or error-correcting mode, depending on mission requirements.
Repeated transmission is requested through an optional Repetitions parameter of the service primitive.
BCH codeword: 56 information bits, 7 parity bits from g(x) = x^7 + x^6 + x^2 + 1 and a final Filler Bit that is always zero, 64 bits (8 octets) in total.
Two rate-1/2 LDPC codes are specified, (n=128, k=64) and (n=512, k=256), with parity-check matrices built from M x M submatrices, M = k/4 = n/8.
The CLTU is Start Sequence + codewords + Tail Sequence; for BCH the Start Sequence is the 16-bit pattern 1110 1011 1001 0000 (0xEB90) and for LDPC the 64-bit pattern 0347 76C7 2728 95B0.
The BCH Tail Sequence is the 64-bit non-correctable pattern C5C5 C5C5 C5C5 C579, which stops the decoding process.

Corrigendum: the optional 128-bit LDPC (128,64) Tail Sequence is now 63A1 ED72 C6AC 79E2 5555 5555 5555 5555 and stops the decoder with probability of roughly 1-10^-4; its derandomized form, which the decoder fails on, is 9C987328 AE457F17 39DC7AF4 640B5D95.
No Tail Sequence is used with LDPC (512,256); a conventional decoder reliably fails to decode when it over-runs the end of the CLTU.

CLTU reception states are S1 INACTIVE, S2 SEARCH and S3 DECODE; events are E1 channel activation, E2 channel deactivation, E3 start sequence found, E4 codeword rejection and E5 tail sequence found (optional, LDPC 128,64).
In S2, no Start Sequence error is allowed in BCH error-detecting mode and one error in error-correcting mode.

Randomizer h(x) = x^8 + x^6 + x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + x + 1 (255-bit period, first bits 1111 1111 0011 1001 ...); always applied with LDPC, and required with BCH unless the designer verifies operation without it.
With BCH the BTG is preset to all ones at the start of the Transfer Frame(s); with LDPC it is preset at the start of each codeword and reset to all ones after each codeword.
PLOP-2 shall be used for missions whose planning began after September 2010; the preferred minimum Acquisition Sequence is 16 octets.
Carrier Modulation Modes: CMM-1 unmodulated carrier, CMM-2 carrier modulated with the acquisition sequence, CMM-3 carrier modulated with CLTUs, CMM-4 carrier modulated with the idle sequence.

Managed parameters: code type, maximum CLTU length, maximum Repetitions, PLOP-1 or PLOP-2; for BCH the decoding mode, allowed Start Sequence errors (0 or 1) and randomizer use; for LDPC the code length and use of the tail sequence. A maximum Repetitions value of 1 means repeated transmission is not available.
The service primitive is ChannelAccess.request (Frame(s), Repetitions); support for Repetitions is optional.

notes: Newer state of the library item ccsds-231-0-231x0b4e1 (the same Issue 4 with EC 1, without the corrigendum). Apart from 5.2.4.2 and the Document Control page, the content matches, but the pagination is one or two PDF pages earlier (for example section 5 starts on p. 29 here, p. 30 there). The old LDPC (128,64) tail was 5555 5556 AAAA AAAA 5555 5555 5555 5555; the corrigendum page carries a 'Cor.1' change mark and a footer 'CCSDS 231.0-B-4 Cor.1 Page 5-1 July 20216', which looks like a typesetting slip for July 2026 (the Document Control footer has the same 'July 20216'). Note 3 of 5.2.4.2 ends with a stray closing quotation mark. Errors carried over as printed: 6.1 says 'When BCG coding is used' (BCH); 4.1 places the Pseudo-Randomizer in 'section 5' (it is section 6); B3 places the LDPC codes in 'section 5' (section 4); 5.3 refers to 'tables 5-1 and 5-2', which the list of tables numbers 5-3 and 5-4. Unlike the EC 1 file, the Annex D note correctly points to 1.7 for normative references. Normative references still cite TC SDLP Issue 3 (2015) and USLP Issue 1 (2018); the library holds newer issues (ccsds-232-0-232x0b4e1c1, ccsds-732-1-732x1b3e1). PDF pages 1 and 2 are covers; the extraction has 51 PDF pages (registry: 50), the last blank. No individual authors are named.
